title: Profile effects now frame your profile card
summary: Profile effects were rebuilt Discord-style: they wrap around your profile card with a big intro, then keep looping.
changes: **Dragons** now coil around your card, breathing mist, fire or lightning, with clouds, flames or a storm
The **Phoenix** rises from below and hovers on top of your card over a wall of fire
**Koi** circle the edges, **butterflies** land on your card, **aurora** and **jellyfish** glow inside it
Every effect plays a big intro when someone opens your profile, then a calmer loop
**Preview** any effect on your own profile card in Dashboard → Collectibles before you buy
